CSV is part of 7 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2025.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (4), [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (2) and [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md) (1).

Most recently: [distance-calculator](@/work/distance-calculator.md); [simple\_geocoder](@/work/simple-geocoder.md); [ctu-cz](@/work/ctu-cz.md): Otevrena data ceskeho telekomunikacniho uradu.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses CSV: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links CSV to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
